learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will learn how humans and animals live in groups, share their work, and help each other to build a happy community!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A community is a big group of people living together in one area, like your neighborhood. We share places like parks, markets, and schools, and we help each other every day!
Our families are our first group! Sometimes new babies are born, or people move to new cities for work. This means the size of our family and community is always changing.
Did you know elephants live in herds and ants live in colonies? Animals stay in groups to find food easily, play together, and protect their babies from danger.
No one can do everything alone. The farmer grows food, the doctor treats us, and the teacher helps us learn. We all depend on each other to live happily!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Community Helpers Drawing!
fun_activity.instructions: Look around your neighborhood and draw two people who help make your community a better place, like a friendly guard, a shopkeeper, or a sweeper. Write a big 'Thank You' on your drawing!

quick_recap: ⭐ People and animals love living in groups because it keeps us safe and happy.
⭐ A community is made of many families who share places and help one another.
⭐ Just like ants work together to build an anthill, human beings work together to build a strong society.
